description: A document whose own top-level `adapter: openai` has no OPENAI_API_KEY in the sandboxed environment fails `cof run`'s preflight check before any effect dispatches (`cli/runtime_shim.py::preflight`, `cli/allowlist.py::walk_orchestration_refs`'s own top-level-adapter inclusion). electricity does not port preflight yet, so it refuses the same document up front with the preview marker instead of comparing output (electricity/DESIGN.md §13).
